site_account.title: Corbel Building Supply: lumber, roofing and siding for Northwest contractors
site_account.description: Fourteen branches from Bellingham to Bend. Contractor credit, jobsite delivery and yards that open at six.
site_account.markdown:
# The contractor's yard, fourteen times over

Corbel stocks framing lumber, roofing and siding at fourteen branches across Washington and Oregon.

## Contractor credit

Open an account and pay on 30-day terms. Most contractors are approved within two days.

## Delivered to the job

Order by three, delivered to the jobsite the next morning.

site_1.title: Cascade Lumber Partners: lumber and panels for framers
site_1.description: Framing lumber, panels and engineered wood for contractors in Washington and Oregon. Deep stock, fast delivery.
site_1.markdown:
# Lumber and panels, in stock

Cascade Lumber Partners supplies framing contractors across Washington and Oregon from four yards.

## Stock you can count on

Dimensional lumber, panels and engineered wood, on the ground, every day.

## Delivery that keeps crews moving

Boom trucks and flatbeds, scheduled around your framing crew.

site_2.title: Meridian Building Products: roofing, siding and windows nationwide
site_2.description: More than 300 branches across the country. Roofing, siding, windows and tools at competitive prices.
site_2.markdown:
# Everything exterior, everywhere

Meridian Building Products distributes roofing, siding and windows from more than 300 branches nationwide.

## Breadth and price

The widest exterior catalog in the country, with national pricing programs for contractors of every size.

## Find your branch

Search by city to find the Meridian branch closest to your next job.

site_3.title: Ironbark Supply: roofing for roofers
site_3.description: Roofing distributor for residential roofers in Idaho and Montana. Three yards, pickup and delivery.
site_3.markdown:
# Roofing, and only roofing

Ironbark Supply serves residential roofers in Idaho and Montana from three yards in Boise, Twin Falls and Missoula.

## Pickup or rooftop delivery

Pick up at the yard or have shingles loaded onto the roof.

## Run by roofers

Our counter staff have worked on roofs. They know what you need.

site_4.title: Summit Pro Yards: lumber yards for custom builders
site_4.description: Lumber, trusses and millwork for custom builders, with design and estimating services at every yard.
site_4.markdown:
# More than a lumber yard

Summit Pro Yards serves custom home builders across eastern Washington with lumber, trusses and millwork.

## Design and estimating included

Our estimators take your plans and return a full material list and quote.

## Built around the builder

A dedicated account manager at every yard.

site_5.title: Northwind Exteriors Supply: siding, windows and doors for remodelers
site_5.description: Order siding, windows and doors online and have them delivered to the jobsite. Built for remodelers in the Portland area.
site_5.markdown:
# Exteriors, ordered online

Northwind Exteriors Supply sells siding, windows and doors to remodelers around Portland.

## Order online, delivered to the job

See stock and prices online, order from the jobsite and get delivery within two days.

## Pay as you go

Card or invoice on each order. No account to open.

site_6.title: Granger & Holt: building materials for production builders
site_6.description: Supplying production home builders across the West since 1955. Volume contracts, installed services and jobsite logistics.
site_6.markdown:
# The supplier behind the West's biggest builders

Granger & Holt supplies production home builders across California, Nevada and Arizona.

## Volume contracts

Annual agreements with fixed pricing and guaranteed stock for your communities.

## Installed services

We supply and install framing packages, roofing and insulation with our own crews.

data.headline: Where Corbel stands among the six distributors it sells against
data.intro: We listed the six distributors closest to Corbel. Each one is placed from what its own website says about who it serves and what it adds beyond the product. A position is a reading of how each one sells, not a market share figure.

competitors.name: Cascade Lumber Partners
competitors.line: Sells lumber and panels to framing contractors in two states from four yards, and competes on stock and delivery.

competitors.name: Meridian Building Products
competitors.line: Sells roofing, siding and windows nationally through more than 300 branches, and leads with breadth of catalog and price.

competitors.name: Ironbark Supply
competitors.line: Sells roofing only, to residential roofers in Idaho and Montana, with pickup or rooftop delivery from three yards.

competitors.name: Summit Pro Yards
competitors.line: Sells lumber, trusses and millwork to custom builders, with design and estimating bundled into every yard.

competitors.name: Northwind Exteriors Supply
competitors.line: Sells exteriors to remodelers around Portland with online ordering and two-day jobsite delivery, and no account to open.

competitors.name: Granger & Holt
competitors.line: Sells to production home builders across the West on annual volume contracts, with installation by its own crews.

account_position.line: Sells lumber, roofing and siding to contractors from fourteen branches, with 30-day contractor credit and next-morning delivery as the hook.

open_space.title: Mid-size contractors who want credit and estimating from one yard
open_space.why: Summit bundles estimating for custom builders and Granger serves production builders on contracts. Nobody serves the contractors between those two with credit, estimating and delivery from one branch network. Corbel already has the credit program and fourteen branches, so estimating is the missing piece.
